title: Pertahankan path prefix base URL di proxy endpoint-try / Keep base-URL path prefix in endpoint-try proxy
summary: ID: Proxy /lab/try kini mempertahankan path prefix upstream (mis. /paid/v1) saat join URL. / EN: The /lab/try proxy now preserves the upstream path prefix (e.g. /paid/v1) when joining URLs.
problem_before: ID: Proxy membuang path prefix base URL sehingga request ke provider ber-prefix (mis. BlazeAPI /paid/v1) salah alamat ke /chat/completions. / EN: The proxy dropped the base-URL path prefix, so requests to prefixed providers (e.g. BlazeAPI /paid/v1) hit the wrong address at /chat/completions.
solution: ID: Fungsi joinUpstreamPath diperbaiki agar menggabungkan prefix upstream dengan path chat/models tujuan. / EN: Fixed the joinUpstreamPath helper to join the upstream prefix with the target chat/models path.
reason: ID: Provider custom ber-prefix tidak dapat dipakai dari tab Coba Endpoint tanpa fix ini. / EN: Prefixed custom providers were unusable from the Try Endpoint tab without this fix.
user_impact: ID: Pengujian endpoint custom ber-prefix di /lab/try kini mencapai path yang benar. / EN: Testing prefixed custom endpoints in /lab/try now reaches the correct path.
tech_impact: ID: Perubahan lokal pada konstruksi URL proxy endpoint-try; tanpa perubahan skema DB. / EN: Local change to endpoint-try proxy URL construction; no DB schema change.
